# PALO Framework

> PALO means Principled AI Lifecycle Orchestration. Created and maintained by Fabrizio Degni, it connects AI governance decisions with risk and impact assessment, controls, indicators and reviewable evidence.

PALO supports governance and educational assessment; it does not certify compliance. PALO-AI is a developer preview, with production limits documented in its capability and readiness pages. Worked examples use synthetic data unless explicitly stated otherwise.

This is a curated index of public resources. Canonical pages remain authoritative. This file grants no permissions and does not change crawler access.

## Start

- [PALO Framework](https://paloframework.org/): Framework definition, authorship and practical entry points.

## Tools and worked examples

- [Two-Lens AI Maturity Assessment](https://paloframework.org/PALO_AIMaturity.html): 22 scoped capability questions, four governance pillars, evidence gaps and explicit historical comparison. Experimental rubric; not a national score, certification or deployment approval.
- [AI maturity methodology](https://paloframework.org/docs/palo-ai-maturity-assessment.html): Sources, evidence ceilings, scope, date checks and pilot-validation limits.

- [AI governance assessment path](https://paloframework.org/PALO_AssessmentPath.html): Connect context, risk, impact, controls, indicators and a local evidence bundle.
- [Fundamental rights impact assessment](https://paloframework.org/PALO_FRIA.html): FRIA tool, scope explanation and a downloadable fictional example.
- [AI governance KPI and KRI generator](https://paloframework.org/PALO_KPIGenerator.html): Select indicators and export a starting register; calibrate thresholds before use.
- [AI risk screening](https://paloframework.org/PALO_RiskTiering.html): Preliminary use-case screening with explicit limitations.
- [KPI and KRI worked examples](https://paloframework.org/docs/ai-governance-kpi-kri-examples.md): Formulas, denominators, accountable owners and a worked downloadable CSV. Canonical web page: https://paloframework.org/docs/ai-governance-kpi-kri-examples.html.
- [AI governance evidence example](https://paloframework.org/docs/ai-governance-evidence-worked-example.md): A fictional invoice-agent case linking authority, expected effects and review conditions. Canonical web page: https://paloframework.org/docs/ai-governance-evidence-worked-example.html.

## Data and methodology

- [Governance datasets and registers](https://paloframework.org/PALO_DataCatalog.html): JSON downloads, versions, licenses, provenance and limits of the indicator register and security crosswalk.
- [OWASP GenAI crosswalk](https://paloframework.org/PALO_OWASPGenAI2026.html): Independent PALO design-fit mapping; not OWASP endorsement or compliance certification.

## Agentic governance

- [PALO-AM methodology](https://paloframework.org/PALO_AgenticGovernance.html): Delegated authority, oversight and evidence for agent actions.
- [PALO-AI developer preview](https://paloframework.org/PALO_AIGovernance.html): Runtime contracts and integration routes; preserve the developer-preview boundary.
- [n8n governance guide](https://paloframework.org/docs/palo-ai-n8n-governance-control-plane.md): Visual integration patterns and the governed action path. Canonical web page: https://paloframework.org/docs/palo-ai-n8n-governance-control-plane.html.
- [PALO MCP services](https://paloframework.org/packages/palo-mcp-server/README.md): Reference service contracts, local validation and production limitations. Canonical web page: https://paloframework.org/packages/palo-mcp-server/README.html.

## Authority and limits

- [Production readiness](https://paloframework.org/PALO_AIProductionReadiness.html): Evidence required before production use and unresolved limitations.
- [Publications and evidence ledger](https://paloframework.org/PALO_Recognition.html): Preferred citation and the distinction between author-led work, public proposals and independent references.

## Semantic deep dive

- [Agentic taxonomy and dictionaries](https://paloframework.org/docs/palo-agentic-taxonomy-and-dictionaries.md): Detailed lifecycle, authority, action, evidence and external-signal vocabularies. Canonical web page: https://paloframework.org/docs/palo-agentic-taxonomy-and-dictionaries.html.
- [Agentic ontologies and verification](https://paloframework.org/docs/palo-agentic-ontologies.md): OWL, SHACL, draft stack relations, JSON contracts and verified limits. Canonical web page: https://paloframework.org/docs/palo-agentic-ontologies.html.
- [Semantic technical catalogues](https://paloframework.org/semantic-catalogues/): Search all 65 inspected JSON Schemas, controlled values and RDF declarations.

## AI FinOps and local learning

- [AI FinOps 1.3](https://paloframework.org/PALO_FinOps.html): Local cost accountability, billing reconciliation, operational review and experimental local-learning economics.
- [Local learning workspace](https://paloframework.org/PALO_FinOps.html#local-learning): Frozen external-only, static hybrid and distilled hybrid comparisons with complete costs, quality and latency gates. Seven synthetic scenarios; no training or demonstrated savings.
- [Research and reproducibility](https://paloframework.org/docs/palo-finops-local-learning-research.html): Roles, evidence limits, preprint v1.0 versus the experimental extension, and an offline report 1.0.1 reproduction package.
- [Local learning method](https://paloframework.org/docs/palo-finops-learning.html): Input contract 1.0.0, report contract 1.0.1, sampling assumptions, full task cost and conditional crossover.
